title: Immutable layer resolution
summary: Resolve one verified standalone Luc and an explicitly ordered Extension list onto detached data. Recompute canonical manifest/files, conflicts, API authority, diff and identity under the Runtime and Host policy.

replaceability.why: The adapter and layering machinery are the Host foundation. If this machinery could be replaced by a creator layer, automatic fallback to the original could not be guaranteed. The Lucs carried by open protocols have their own replacement classes.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, self-Luc spec v0.3, 2026-10-18; interface charter rule 6, 2026-10-22

reach.notes: Trusted Host machinery, not authority granted to a Luc. Package calls remain bounded by their resolved permissions, Host APIs and editable scope.

operations.name: resolve_luc

base_input.description: Verified immutable LucArtifact or source path; manifest shape is docs/luc/schemas/artifact-manifest-v1.schema.json.

items.description: Verified immutable LucArtifact or source path; manifest shape is docs/luc/schemas/artifact-manifest-v1.schema.json.

output.description: Canonical frozen ResolvedLuc; public receipt shape is iface:luc.resolver/v1.

operations.notes: No deadline. Ordered immutable inputs produce a deterministic resolution; accepts artifacts or paths. Path verification and manifest/source-patch helpers can raise further distribution codes. Draft only for the transitive error union, not composition order.

operations.name: public

self.description: Canonical frozen ResolvedLuc; public receipt shape is iface:luc.resolver/v1.

operations.notes: No deadline is enforced by this synchronous Python seam. Retrying a read observes the current state.

invariants.text: Manifest/file patches produce detached derived output, preserving Base and Extension source bytes.
Only a standalone Luc can be the Base and each Extension names that exact Base, never another Extension.

break: The operation rejects invalid input, integrity, authority or binding state as described by its operation.

conformance.notes: Existing tests listed here were inspected, not run for this documentation task. The area checker validates the contract files; it does not exercise runtime behavior.
